programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Cuando Sun Mei y Rojo desaparecen, el grupo debe decidir si seguir buscándolos o partir hacia Nuevamérica.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Siguiendo el sueño de Warren, el grupo prosigue a través de lo que parece un inacabable paisaje devastado.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: En una compleja instalación subterránea, una misteriosa entidad captura al grupo.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Lucy intenta salvar a Murphy mientras Warren y los demás se enfrentan a un zombi modificado biológicamente.
programme.sub-title: Vuelto de Entre los No Muertos

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Warren no logra evitar que Murphy y los demás cometan una atrocidad por mera venganza.

programme.title: Z Nation
programme.desc: Warren y el grupo se encuentran con un extraño que parece ser un profanador de tumbas.

programme.title: La fugitiva
programme.desc: Frank Johnson se convierte en testigo ocular de un asesinato. Su esposa, la policía y el asesino lo persiguen por San Francisco.

programme.title: El malvado Zaroff
programme.desc: El conde Zaroff es un loco millonario que vive en una isla solitaria y se dedica a cazar a los náufragos como si fueran animales.

programme.title: Un cubo de sangre
programme.desc: Un ayudante de camarero tonto es aclamado como artista por un gato muerto cubierto de yeso que se confunde con una hábil estatuilla. El deseo de más elogios pronto conduce a una serie de obras cada vez más mortales.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: La Senda
programme.desc: En un intento por salvar su matrimonio, Raúl decide pasar las Navidades con su familia en una cabaña aislada en medio de la nieve. Durante la Nochebuena todo parece marchar bien, pero, de repente, la situación da un giro totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: La relación de Alex y Evan toma un giro diferente a medida que ambos comienzan de nuevo. Kelly da un salto hacia lo desconocido y Christian propone a Chloe, el nuevo jefe de Miranda, con una canción.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Kelly tiene la mejor noche de su vida, mientras que Alex y Rex tienen una de las más difíciles. Evan se sumerge en el mundo publicitario.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: Hannibal: El origen del mal
programme.desc: El joven Hannibal empieza a tramar una venganza después de que su hermanita sea asesinada durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Basada en la novela de Thomas Harris.

programme.title: La casa de Jack
programme.desc: EE.UU. años setenta. Seguimos al inteligentísimo Jack durante cinco incidentes y descubrimos los asesinatos que le definen como asesino en serie. Vivimos la historia desde la perspectiva de Jack. Considera cada asesinato como una obra de arte...

programme.title: Crímenes del futuro
programme.desc: Los humanos están mutando y el dolor prácticamente ha desaparecido. En este nuevo mundo, dos artistas performativos han hecho de las operaciones un exitoso y lucrativo arte.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Aparece una joven Mutante Nueva del pasado de Adam, buscando venganza por la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: El equipo se encuentra con un mutante que mata a otros mutantes al drenar su energía y también puede volver a la vida después de ser asesinado.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Una Soberana Paliza
programme.desc: La ex reina Elida está acorralada por su némesis, por lo que un viejo amigo acude en su ayuda y le trae grandes noticias.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: ¡Jerónimo!
programme.desc: El equipo se ve obligado a detenerse para reparaciones, pero los caníbales que residen allí tienen otros planes

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Reina de Nadie
programme.desc: Elida se ocupa de la vida que dejó atrás; Isaac y Amae se encuentran en un territorio de riesgo.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Después de quedar varado cerca de un agujero negro, el capitán Dylan Hunt es descubierto por un barco de salvamento mercenario y descubre que ha estado congelado en el tiempo durante 300 años.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: Dylan protege a la Andrómeda de los mercenarios mientras Beka comienza a preguntarse si están luchando por el lado equivocado.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Aflojando el Fatídico Relámpago
programme.desc: Dylan encuentra una estación espacial llena de niños que creen que está allí para traer la paz matando a sus enemigos.

programme.title: Andrómeda: D Menos Cero
programme.desc: La tripulación de Andrómeda todavía está aprendiendo a trabajar juntos mientras son atacados por los Restauradores.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Doble Hélice
programme.desc: La Andrómeda se involucra en una disputa entre un planeta Than y una colonia Nietzschean.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Ángel Oscuro, Demonio Brillante
programme.desc: Una corriente de deslizamiento envía a la Andrómeda de vuelta en el tiempo a justo antes de que cayera la Mancomunidad. La tripulación debe intervenir para preservar la historia.

programme.title: Andrómeda: Los Lazos que Atan
programme.desc: Responder a una llamada de socorro lleva a la tripulación a recoger al hermano de Beka, ahora un Wayist, y a su amigo.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Tal para cual
programme.desc: Dresden se ocupa del caso de un chico que asegura que le acechan unos monstruos, pero un tropiezo de Harry pone a todos en peligro.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: El caso Boone
programme.desc: Dresden investiga el caso de un padre a quien se le aparece su hija, pero las circunstancias que rodean su asesinato llevan a Harry por un camino que pone en peligro a Connie.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Un trago para la resaca
programme.desc: El FBI investiga el caso de Murphy, en el que un asesino en serie le quita el pelo y los dientes a la víctima, pero la razón podría ir más allá de coger al asesino.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Las reglas del compromiso
programme.desc: Harry descubre una desagradable alianza cuando trata de proteger a su clienta de un demonio.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Nathan, Kelly, Curtis, Alisha y Simon son un grupo de inadaptados que no tienen nada en común. Están realizando servicios comunitarios cuando los sorprende una fuerte tormenta que los dota de superpoderes.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Nathan está desesperado por volver a casa y, cuando la pandilla hace un descubrimiento, ve su gran oportunidad.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 3
programme.desc: Alisha se divierte usando y abusando de sus poderes, pero parece que no puede conseguir al hombre que desea de verdad: Curtis.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Sally, el trabajador a prueba de la banda, descubre la tarjeta de crédito de Tony en la taquilla de Simon y está convencido de que la banda está implicada en su desaparición.

programme.title: Misfits: Episodio 5
programme.desc: Decidida a probar que la banda estuvo implicada en la desaparición de Tony, Sally se centra en su investigación en el vínculo más débil.

programme.title: City of Industry
programme.desc: Four men come together for a Palm Springs jewelry heist. Ringleader Lee (Timothy Hutton) invites his older brother Roy (Harvey Keitel) to join Jorge (Wade Dominguez) and their weapons procurer and driver, Skip (Stephen Dorff). The robbery goes off flawlessly, but Skip attempts to double-cross the gang afterward, killing two of them. Only Roy is left alive to pursue him across Los Angeles, through the criminal underbelly of strip clubs and reckless killers.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: The 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: The Limey
programme.desc: The Limey follows Wilson (Terence Stamp), a tough English ex-con who travels to Los Angeles to avenge his daughter's death. Upon arrival, Wilson goes to task battling Valentine (Peter Fonda) and an army of L.A.'s toughest criminals, hoping to find clues and piece together what happened. After surviving a near-death beating, getting thrown from a building and being chased down a dangerous mountain road, the Englishman decides to dole out some bodily harm of his own.

programme.title: The International
programme.desc: Interpol agent Louis Salinger (Clive Owen) joins forces with New York prosecutor Eleanor Whitman (Naomi Watts) to put an end to a powerful bank's funding of terrorism. As they follow the money from Germany to Italy to New York to Turkey, Salinger and Whitman find their own lives are at risk from those who will stop at nothing to protect their interests.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: Speed 2: Cruise Control
programme.desc: Annie and her new SWAT boyfriend take a romantic cruise to the Caribbean. The ship is infiltrated by a crazy, bitter, demon, genius who is adept at computer and is intent on blowing up the ship and destroying all on board.

programme.title: Speed (1994)
programme.desc: An L.A. cop (Keanu Reeves) trapped on a runaway city bus set to explode if it falls under 50 mph must help one of the terrified passengers (Sandra Bullock) steer the bus to safety!

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Taut thriller about a young law student whose legal brief about the assassination of two Supreme Court justices causes her to be targeted by killers. She realizes just how accurate her accusations have been when her lover and mentor is murdered. Forced to go on the run in New Orleans, she is aided by a journalist who helps her unravel a conspiracy involving senior government figures.

programme.title: Triple 9
programme.desc: Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

programme.desc: In New Orleans, a feisty retiree (Shirley MacLaine) and her new neighbor, an uptight widower (Christopher Plummer), discover that it's never too late for true love and romance.

programme.desc: Grace lives an idyllic life in a British seaside town, but her world soon comes crashing down when her husband of 29 years tells her he's leaving her for another woman. Through stages of shock, disbelief and anger -- and with support from her son -- Grace ultimately regains her footing while learning it's never too late to be happy.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay comes the best 'Transformers' ever! With humanity facing extinction from a terrifying new threat, it's up to the Autobots to save Earth. They'll need new allies, including inventor Cade (Mark Wahlberg) and the Dinobots!

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive.

programme.title: Snake Eyes
programme.desc: Detective Rick Santoro (Nicolas Cage) has never played by the rules. When he attends a high-profile boxing match with his friend Navy Cmdr. Kevin Dunne (Gary Sinise), as well as Defense Secretary Kirkland (Joel Fabiani), he witnesses a terrorist assassinate Kirkland. Despite a lockdown on the arena, key witness Julia Costello (Carla Gugino) escapes -- and Santoro begins to suspect Kirkland's death is part of a much larger conspiracy that involves boxing rivals and a beautiful stranger.

programme.title: Kiss the Girls
programme.desc: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

programme.title: The Shadow Riders
programme.desc: Two brothers return home at the end of the war to find their family has been kidnapped by Confederate forces.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: An eccentric drifter claiming to be Elvis catches a ride with a grieving widower.

programme.title: Robot And Frank
programme.desc: Set in the near future, Robot and Frank is a buddy movie about an elderly ex thief and his caretaker robot.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: Two custodians hold onto their sanity while living in a bunker with frozen people meant to repopulate society.

programme.title: Jason and the Argonauts
programme.desc: After saving the life of his royal father's usurper, Pelias (Douglas Wilmer), whom he fails to recognize, Jason (Todd Armstrong) is encouraged by the conniving murderer to begin a quest in search of the Golden Fleece. In doing so, Pelias hopes for Jason's death to thwart the prophecy that he will reclaim the throne. Along the journey, Jason is protected by the goddess Hera (Honor Blackman), and his crew includes Hercules (Nigel Green) and Acastus (Gary Raymond), a saboteur planted by Pelias.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Set in the Libyan desert in 1942 where a group of American soldiers become isolated in their tank during the retreat to El Alamein. As they drive across the desert they pick up a group of Allied stragglers, but with their supplies of fuel, food and water running low, they try to reach a desert fortress, but a large German detachment is also heading there.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Clerk Freddie Clegg, an avid butterfly collector, wins a football pool and buys a country house with a large basement. He then kidnaps art student Miranda Grey, a longtime crush of his, after trailing her in a van. Freddie locks Miranda in the basement, and buys her clothes and books, so that she can get to know him. They initially agree that she will stay at the house for a month, but Miranda fears what will happen when the time comes for her to leave.

programme.title: Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: War heroes Rip Murdock (Humphrey Bogart) and Johnny Drake (William Prince) are sent to Washington, D.C., by train, but are not told why. During the trip, they learn they're about to receive top honors for their service. Johnny, seemingly terrified by the publicity that awaits him, jumps off the train and later turns up dead. Suspecting foul play, Rip begins digging into his pal's past. He encounters cover-ups, threats to his own life and deadly femme fatale Coral Chandler (Lizabeth Scott).

programme.title: Whats Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Taking care of Arnie is mostly Gilbert's task, which can be pretty demanding, at least while you are working at the local grocery store.

programme.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
programme.desc: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A neurotic, twice divorced sci-fi writer moves back in with his mom to solve his personal problems.

programme.title: Tremors: Shrieker Island
programme.desc: Burt Gummer must save the day when a wealthy playboy unleashes a gigantic, carnivorous worm and other monsters on a tropical island.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky

programme.title: Le Quatuor Ebène
programme.sub-title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination. In their live appearances, tours and concerts, plus a succession of recordings built on the cornerstone of four albums made between 1960 and 1963, Loussier's group achieved the breakthrough to popular commercial success enjoyed by only a select few jazz musicians. In fifteen years, the trio sold over six million albums! On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio perform a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig - the city where Bach composed many of his most famous works.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Charles Mingus, Jaki Byard, Dannie Richmond & Johnny Coles
programme.sub-title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet). Recorded within an eight-day span, less than three months before Dolphy's death, the three concerts showcase Mingus's visionary leadership and the band's incredible depth and diversity with unique performances and arrangements of classics including ‘So Long Eric' and the groundbreaking ‘Meditations On Integration'.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth' trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Jacques Bailly, Willy Donni, Bruno Castellucci & José Bedeur
programme.sub-title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax' took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival. The second highlight of the festival is a trio of Belgian pianist François Boland, who appeared with American bassist Jimmy Woode and Belgian drummer Freddy Rottier. They are joined by four international guest saxophonists: German tenorist Klaus Doldinger, Belgian altoist Jacques Pelzer, British altoist Derek Humble, and Austrian saxophonist Karl Drewo. Following individual solo features and a joint encore, a true saxophone legend appears on stage: veteran American tenorist Coleman Hawkins. Accompanied by his compatriots Jimmy Woode (bass) and “Kansas” Fields (drums) and French pianist George Arvanitas, Coleman Hawkins plays an hour-long concert that includes "Disorder At The Border", "Autumn Leaves", "Lover Come Back To Me", "Moonlight In Vermont", "All The Things You Are" and “Ow!”. This concert is the perfect conclusion of the first jazz festival in honor of Adolphe Sax.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer & Budapest Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók's best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work's instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: John Denver
programme.sub-title: Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan
programme.desc: Arguably one of the most beloved American performers of the 20th century, John Denver had a career that saw him sell over 40 million albums worldwide while winning numerous awards, including 2 Grammy Awards, 3 AMA's, 1 Emmy and 2 CMA's. "Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan" is a 1981 concert from his 7-show tour of Japan and features a wonderful selection of hits from his career, including 4 of his 5 #1 hits: "Annie's Song", "Calypso", "Sunshine On My Shoulders" & "Thank God I'm A Country Boy".

programme.title: Pixies
programme.desc: The Pixies are one of the most influential American acts of all time. Initially spanning the late eighties and early nineties they created the blueprint for alternative rock that would be followed and embellished upon by everyone from grunge to Britpop. After 10 years apart the Pixies reformed in 2004. This film is the second release in the Club Date series and features the Pixies in the intimate Paradise Club in Boston. It is a companion to the simultaneously released “Pixies Acoustic: Live In Newport”.

programme.title: Supertramp
programme.desc: Supertramp's “Breakfast In America” was the biggest selling album in the world in 1979. It spawned several hit singles and went on to win two Grammy Awards and sell in excess of 20 million copies. Following the album's release Supertramp embarked on a 10 month world tour which arrived in Paris at the end of November. This show from the Pavillon de Paris was both filmed and recorded and now for the first time the full length audio and the concert film are combined in one set. The concert features the different song-writing styles of Roger Hodgson and Rick Davies, who each composed the songs on which they sing lead vocals.

programme.title: Pixels

programme.title: Year One
programme.desc: After eating from the Tree of Knowledge, a primitive villager/slacker flees his people and encounters murderous Cain, slave traders, charismatic nutcase Abraham, and finally the city of Sodom. There the man falls for a princess, is hailed as "the chosen" by the oppressed people and ultimately leads a revolt that topples the government and frees the slaves. He heads off with the princess to visit Egypt....

programme.title: Man Of The House (2005)
programme.desc: A hard-edged Texas Ranger is forced to go undercover as an assistant cheerleading coach to protect a group of college cheerleaders after they witness a murder.

programme.title: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: (2010) Tense thriller starring Kristanna Loken. A young woman is drawn into a web of deception when she arrives in New York to settle the affairs of her murdered best friend.

programme.title: Mommy's Cheating Scandal
programme.desc: (2021) Thriller based on real-life events, with Karis Cameron. A student gets caught in an admission scandal in a bid to get into a good college. A manhunt for the ring leader has deadly consequences.

programme.title: Secrets That Kill
programme.desc: Jenny is unhappy when her mum Laura returns from a world cruise with a new younger husband.

programme.title: Hidden Truth
programme.desc: (2016) Intense thriller with Sarah Lind. After her brother is accused of murder, Jamie tries to clear his name, uncovering dark secrets and a killer who will do anything to get away with it...

programme.title: Lies and Deception
programme.desc: (2005) Thriller with Twin Peaks star Mädchen Amick. A private investigator helps a women discover the truth about her husband's apparent suicide.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Grace (Selena Gomez) is an ordinary girl who becomes an accidental princess when a family summer trip to Paris turns into the fantasy of a lifetime. Living like royalty, Grace, along with her two best friends, discovers who she really is – by assuming another person's identity.

programme.title: The Pink Panther
programme.desc: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, France is in an uproar. Fortunately, Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case with his trusted partner Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno). Will he seduce the pop diva, Xania (Beyoncé Knowles)?

programme.title: She's The Man
programme.desc: Viola (Amanda Bynes), disguised as her twin brother, joins the high school boys' soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke (Channing Tatum) the hot star forward.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

programme.title: The Way Ahead
programme.desc: World War II drama that traces a bunch of British draftees as they go through tough basic training and end up getting deployed to North Africa.

programme.title: A Love to Remember
programme.desc: After a year of interacting exclusively online, Tenley, an eco-conscious horticulturist, finally works up the courage to meet her online crush, Jared. When Jared doesn't show because of a bike accident, Tenley gets mistaken for his wife at the hospital. Soon, she's forced to keep the lie up with Jared's entire family and his annoyingly charming best friend, Everett in order to save Jared's company... You've Got Mail meets While You Were Sleeping!

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.sub-title: Incident At Victoria Falls Part One
programme.desc: King Edward asks Sherlock Holmes to perform one more task before his retirement: to safeguard the Star of Africa on a trip to Cape Town. Soon the fabled jewel is stolen and several people end up being murdered.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.sub-title: Incident At Victoria Falls Part Two
programme.desc: King Edward asks Sherlock Holmes to perform one more task before his retirement: to safeguard the Star of Africa on a trip to Cape Town. Soon the fabled jewel is stolen and several people end up being murdered.

programme.title: Keep the Aspidistra Flying
programme.desc: Gordon Comstock quits his job at an advertising agency in order to write poetry, only to find that poets, like everyone else, need money.

programme.title: Hot Pursuit (2015)
programme.desc: In this riotous spin on the mismatched buddy movie, an uptight and by-the-book cop (Reese Witherspoon) tries to protect the gregarious widow (Sofía Vergara) of a drug boss as they race through Texas pursued by crooked cops and murderous gunmen!

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Old-school salesmen Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) try to reboot their careers by joining Google's fiercely competitive internship program — with hilarious results!

programme.title: Labyrinth
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Sarah must solve a labyrinth to rescue her baby brother when he is taken by the Goblin King.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: A mortal teams with the god Horus in an alliance against Set, the god of darkness, who usurped Egypt's throne.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: The legendary Cimmerian warrior, Conan, fights an epic battle against hulking rivals, horrific monsters, and impossible odds, as he realizes he is the only one who can save the great nations of Hyboria from an encroaching reign of supernatural evil.

programme.title: The Fall
programme.desc: A bedridden hospital patient captivates a girl with a tale of heroes, myths, and villains on a desert island.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Banished by the king, Hercules harnesses his powers and gathers an army to fight his way back to his kingdom.

programme.title: Gladiatress
programme.desc: 55BC Somewhere In Britain: The Princesses of the Dubonni tribe are three unlikely sisters: Smirgut The Fierce (Fiona Allen), ferocious warrior and full-time mum, Dwyfuc (Doon Mackichan), desperate spinster in search of a hairy husband and Worthaboutapig (Sally Phillips), clumsy village bee-herder. Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: Office Uprising
programme.desc: Get ready for the worst work day ever in this absurdly funny zombie infestation! An underachiever (Brenton Thwaites: Pirates of the Caribbean: Salazars Revenge) working at a weapons manufacturing firm must rescue his one true love from psychotic zombie co-workers who have been weaponized by Zolt, a new energy drink. Co-starring Jane Levy (Dont Breathe) and Karan Soni (Deadpool).

programme.title: Mythica: The Dark Spore
programme.desc: Certain to enthral fans of Game of Thrones -the second in this fantastical franchise is darker than ever. When a powerful relic is stolen, Marek faces a new sinister enemy, set on reclaiming the Darkspore for his master Szorlok. Now Marek and her friends must race through creature-infested lands, to an abandoned underground city, to save themselves from an imminent deadly evil.

programme.title: Rubikon
programme.desc: All they can do is watch as the world burns. The emergence of an extinction event on Earth leaves the inhabitants of a space station in horror, as they witness the end of humanity unfold before their very eyes. Does the crew risk their lives to get back home during the global catastrophe and search for survivors or remain safe and watch as life as they know it comes to an end?

programme.title: Escape Plan II
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for the second installment of the electrifying action franchise, with on-screen forces Sylvester Stallone and Dave Bautista. Years after Ray Breslin fought his way out of an escape-proof prison, he's organised a new top-notch, for-hire security force that includes some of the best in the business. But when one of his team goes missing, Ray ventures back into the secret lock-up.

programme.title: Evening
programme.desc: An all-star cast of the greatest actresses of our time - including Vanessa Redgrave, Meryl Streep, Toni Collette, Claire Danes, Natasha Richardson and Glenn Close - come together in this passionate and heartwarming story.

programme.title: Jazzy

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway

The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.

programme.desc: The perpetually unlucky David Walsh (Matt Dillon) thinks he finally has it made after landing his dream job at a bank and getting engaged to Sara (Christina Applegate), a seemingly perfect woman. But in a single day, he's let go at work and his fiancée breaks up with him. Livid, David decides to come back to the bank armed and confront his boss, but, as he does so, a heist takes place. David's day somehow gets worse as the robbers draw him into their violent scheme.

programme.title: A Little Trip to Heaven
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Abraham Holt travels to a tiny town in rural Minnesota to look into a particularly unusual insurance claim stemming from a horrific car accident. As Holt examines the scene of the wreck, it all seems a bit too perfect. And when he interviews Isold McBride and her shifty husband, Fred -- the impoverished beneficiaries of the massive, recently initiated life-insurance policy -- he begins to suspect that something is amiss.

programme.title: Children of the Corn
programme.desc: As physician Burt Stanton (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend, Vicky (Linda Hamilton), drive across the Midwest to his new job, their trip comes to a sudden halt when they encounter the body of a murdered boy in the road. In trying to contact the authorities, Burt and Vicky wander into a small town populated only by children, followers of sinister young preacher Isaac Chroner (John Franklin). Soon the couple is fleeing the youthful fanatics, who want to sacrifice them to their demonic deity.

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: Knight George (James Purefoy) returns to England for a peaceful life after the Crusades. But first he promises King Edgar (Simon Callow) to find his missing daughter, Princess Luna (Piper Perabo), in exchange for a plot of land. George discovers the princess has been taken by a dragon, which apparently died after laying an egg. But Luna refuses to abandon the unhatched dragon, so George must return both princess and egg to the king -- while avoiding Luna's determined fiancé (Patrick Swayze).

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, The Cowboys a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves reigned over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate had finally caught up with them - and now the merciless gang has but a single surviving member. When a deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy, the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.title: Cover-Up [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Le Quatuor Ebène
programme.sub-title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination. In their live appearances, tours and concerts, plus a succession of recordings built on the cornerstone of four albums made between 1960 and 1963, Loussier's group achieved the breakthrough to popular commercial success enjoyed by only a select few jazz musicians. In fifteen years, the trio sold over six million albums! On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio perform a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig - the city where Bach composed many of his most famous works.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Charles Mingus, Jaki Byard, Dannie Richmond & Johnny Coles
programme.sub-title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet). Recorded within an eight-day span, less than three months before Dolphy's death, the three concerts showcase Mingus's visionary leadership and the band's incredible depth and diversity with unique performances and arrangements of classics including ‘So Long Eric' and the groundbreaking ‘Meditations On Integration'.

programme.title: Lianne La Havas
programme.desc: Lianne La Havas' performance at Casino de Paris captures the British singer-songwriter at her best: with her crystalline voice she performs soulful melodies full of sincerity. The performance is part of La Havas' 'Blood Tour', a concert tour promoting her second album 'Blood' (2015). She is accompanied by James Wyatt on keys, Adam Prendergast on bass, Giles King Ashong on drums, and Frida Touray on backing vocals.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth' trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. He has worked with numerous legends, including Bill Withers, Herbie Hancock, Sting, and Dianne Reeves, and his album ‘Bad Ass and Blind' was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Jazz Vocal Album in 2018. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Raul Midón
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017's Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón's performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound. No wonder the Sing Jazz audience were ecstatic!

programme.title: Jacques Bailly, Willy Donni, Bruno Castellucci & José Bedeur
programme.sub-title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax' took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival. The second highlight of the festival is a trio of Belgian pianist François Boland, who appeared with American bassist Jimmy Woode and Belgian drummer Freddy Rottier. They are joined by four international guest saxophonists: German tenorist Klaus Doldinger, Belgian altoist Jacques Pelzer, British altoist Derek Humble, and Austrian saxophonist Karl Drewo. Following individual solo features and a joint encore, a true saxophone legend appears on stage: veteran American tenorist Coleman Hawkins. Accompanied by his compatriots Jimmy Woode (bass) and “Kansas” Fields (drums) and French pianist George Arvanitas, Coleman Hawkins plays an hour-long concert that includes "Disorder At The Border", "Autumn Leaves", "Lover Come Back To Me", "Moonlight In Vermont", "All The Things You Are" and “Ow!”. This concert is the perfect conclusion of the first jazz festival in honor of Adolphe Sax.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer & Budapest Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach's Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók's best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta. Remarkable is the work's instrumentation: Bartók divided the strings into two groups that are placed on opposite sides of the stage, to create antiphonal effects. The program ends with Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F major, Op. 90. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on December 4, 2017.

programme.title: Royal Opera Orchestra & Andres Gabetta
programme.desc: We all know "The Four Seasons of Vivaldi", it is one of the "hits" of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi's famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV? The two works are finally presented in the same program in spite of their differences: the well-known virtuosity of Vivaldi's work contrasts with the mixture of French good taste and Italian features of Guido's Seasons. It is also the first time that the version with strings and winds is filmed. For this exciting confrontation, the Royal Opera Orchestra will be conducted by the virtuoso Andrès Gabetta, from his 1727 Venetian Pietro Guarneri violin, an exact contemporary of these Eight Seasons!

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Paul Simon
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: Rod Stewart
programme.desc: A concert by the legendary Rod Stewart, that closed Radio 2's Annual Festival In A Day, held in September 2015 in London's Hyde Park.

programme.title: John Denver
programme.sub-title: Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan
programme.desc: Arguably one of the most beloved American performers of the 20th century, John Denver had a career that saw him sell over 40 million albums worldwide while winning numerous awards, including 2 Grammy Awards, 3 AMA's, 1 Emmy and 2 CMA's. "Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan" is a 1981 concert from his 7-show tour of Japan and features a wonderful selection of hits from his career, including 4 of his 5 #1 hits: "Annie's Song", "Calypso", "Sunshine On My Shoulders" & "Thank God I'm A Country Boy".

programme.title: Pixies
programme.desc: The Pixies are one of the most influential American acts of all time. Initially spanning the late eighties and early nineties they created the blueprint for alternative rock that would be followed and embellished upon by everyone from grunge to Britpop. After 10 years apart the Pixies reformed in 2004. This film is the second release in the Club Date series and features the Pixies in the intimate Paradise Club in Boston. It is a companion to the simultaneously released “Pixies Acoustic: Live In Newport”.

programme.title: Supertramp
programme.desc: Supertramp's “Breakfast In America” was the biggest selling album in the world in 1979. It spawned several hit singles and went on to win two Grammy Awards and sell in excess of 20 million copies. Following the album's release Supertramp embarked on a 10 month world tour which arrived in Paris at the end of November. This show from the Pavillon de Paris was both filmed and recorded and now for the first time the full length audio and the concert film are combined in one set. The concert features the different song-writing styles of Roger Hodgson and Rick Davies, who each composed the songs on which they sing lead vocals.

programme.title: Los viajes de Gulliver
programme.desc: El barco en el que viaja Gulliver naufraga y el mar le arrastra a la costa del país de Lilliput, un lugar habitado por unos hombrecillos diminutos. Al despertar, Gulliver descubre que ha caído prisionero de estos entrañables seres. Sin embargo, cuando la princesa de Lilliput y el príncipe de un reino vecino están a punto de casarse, se desata una absurda guerra entre ambos pueblos y Gulliver deberá utilizar su ingenio para salvar la ceremonia.

programme.title: ¡Agáchate, maldito!

programme.title: Fuera de control
programme.desc: Will Graham es un hombre con oscuro pasado, que decide cambiar su vida, pero la desaparición de su hermano le obligará a volver para investigar la verdad de lo sucedido.

programme.title: Espacio/Tiempo
programme.desc: En un futuro al borde del colapso, unos científicos desarrollan una turbina para realizar viajes interestelares que podría salvar a la humanidad. Cuando les cortan la financiación por un fatal accidente, deciden recurrir a actividades delictivas para reconstruir su máquina.

programme.title: El escritor
programme.desc: Oso de Plata al Mejor Director en el Festival de Berlín 2010. Roman Polanski dirige un apasionado thriller político cargado de suspense en un mundo en el que nada es lo que parece.

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: Años 20, durante los últimos días del Imperio Otomano. Michael (Oscar Isaac), un brillante estudiante de medicina, y Chris (Christian Bale), un prestigioso periodista americano, se enamoran de la misma mujer, la bella y sofisticada Ana, en medio del brutal genocidio armenio de 1915.

programme.title: Azul y no tan rosa
programme.desc: Diego es un joven fotógrafo exitoso que vive en el glamoroso mundo de la moda, la superficialidad y el exceso. Un brutal ataque homófobo trastoca su vida cuando su pareja queda en coma. Justo en ese terrible momento, Diego, inesperadamente, debe cuidar de su hijo Armando...

programme.title: Evelyn
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, narra como en la Irlanda de los años cincuenta la pequeña Evelyn y sus dos hermanos son separados y enviados a distintos orfanatos católicos, cuando un tribunal decide que su padre es incapaz de cuidar de ellos.

programme.title: Warrior (2011)
programme.desc: Warrior cuenta la inspiradora historia de una familia separada que encuentra redención en el sitio menos esperado... un ring de artes marciales mixtas.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Walter y Kitty son una pareja de ingleses que deciden casarse por motivos equivocados y se establecen en Shanghai. En esta exótica ciudad, ella se enamora de otro hombre.

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: Años 20, durante los últimos días del Imperio Otomano. Michael (Oscar Isaac), un brillante estudiante de medicina, y Chris (Christian Bale), un prestigioso periodista americano, se enamoran de la misma mujer, la bella y sofisticada Ana, en medio del brutal genocidio armenio de 1915.

programme.title: Phillip Morris ¡Te quiero!
programme.desc: La improbable pero cierta historia de Steven Russell, un vendedor de una pequeña localidad de Estados Unidos que acaba en la cárcel. Allí conoce a un presidiario, Phillip Morris, del que se enamorará perdidamente.

programme.title: Noche real
programme.desc: 8 de mayo de 1945, día de la victoria en Europa. La ciudad de Londres celebra el final de la guerra, y en Buckingham Palace, la princesa Margarita y su hermana Isabel están deseando ser parte de la alegría fuera de palacio. A ambas se les permite salir de incógnito para formar partes de las celebraciones, dando comienzo a una noche llena de emoción, peligro y romance.

programme.title: Perdidos en el Pacífico
programme.desc: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, tres aviadores de la Marina de los EE.UU. sufren un accidente en mar abierto. Sin comida, agua, ni esperanza de rescate, los soldados se verán obligados a navegar sin rumbo en un pequeño bote salvavidas.

programme.title: Los papeles de Aspern
programme.desc: Venecia, siglo XIX. Un ambicioso editor está obsesionado con el poeta romántico Jeffrey Aspern y su corta y romántica vida. Por ello viaja de los Estados Unidos a Venecia decidido a conseguir las cartas que Aspern envió a su amante y musa, una mujer que guarda celosamente sus secretos

programme.title: La mirada del amor
programme.desc: Cinco años después de perder el amor de su vida, Nikki se enamora de nuevo a primera vista. Tom es el hombre de sus sueños un atractivo profesor de arte con un gran corazón, sonrisa amable y mucha vitalidad. Su parecido físico con Garrett, su difunto marido, es asombroso. Seducida por la oportunidad de volver a vivir su primer amor verdadero, Nikki se sumerge en un mundo de fantasía con Tom como Garrett, sabiendo que tarde o temprano deberá revelar la verdad.

programme.title: Guillaume y los chicos, ¡a la mesa!
programme.desc: Película biográfica con toques de comedia sobre el cineasta y artista Guillaume Gallienne. Se centra sobre todo en la estrecha relación que tenía con su madre. Un recorrido por las emociones, los recuerdos y la familia.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos cambian cuando el profesor de filosofía es confundido un traficante de drogas.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: En temporada baja
programme.desc: Sigue la supuesta camaradería formada por Alberto, "el crack", quien fue un exitoso representante de futbolistas que ahora vive en un camping a las afueras de Valencia, y Charly, un policía divorciado que duerme en el trabajo.

programme.title: Abajo el amor
programme.desc: Nueva York, 1962. Barbara Novak es una escritora feminista cuyo libro "Abajo el amor", se ha convertido en la guía que siguen las mujeres de todo el mundo. Convencido de que Novak es un fraude, el reportero estrella de una revista masculina intenta desenmascararla, haciendo que se enamore de él...

programme.title: El club de las madres solteras
programme.desc: Cuando cinco madres solteras luchadoras apartan sus diferencias para formar un grupo de apoyo, encuentran la inspiración y la risa en su nueva hermandad, y se ayudan unas a otras a superar los obstáculos a los que se enfrentan.

programme.title: Siete días y una vida
programme.desc: El mundo perfecto de una bella reportera de televisión Seattle queda desmoronado por la predicción de su muerte en siete días.

programme.title: Rumores Y Mentiras
programme.desc: El guión, obra del dramaturgo Bert V. Royal, es una versión moderna y en clave estudiantil de “La letra escarlata”, la novela de Nathaniel Hawthorne. Narra la historia de una joven que decide fingir que lleva una vida promiscua, creyendo que así obtendrá algún tipo de beneficio. Sin embargo, las circunstancias se volverán en su contra.

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: Rogers y Clarke (Warren Beatty y Dustin Hoffman) son dos ineptos compositores sin suerte y desesperados por dinero. El dúo acepta el consejo de su sospechoso agente, y en un abrir y cerrar de ojos está en un recorrido por la mística república de Ishtar. A su llegada, nuestros héroes son reclutados por separado como espías de los bandos contrarios de una revolución planeada, y al mismo tiempo se disputan la atención de una hermosa revolucionaria (Isabelle Adjani). Sin embargo, Clarke y Rogers son peores espías que compositores, y en poco tiempo terminan varados en el desierto en compañía de un camello ciego y de varios asesinos de la CIA.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds
programme.desc: Deeds (Adam Sandler) es un ingenuo provinciano que vive en un pueblo de New Hampshire. Como propietario de "Deeds' Pizza", la única pizzeria del pueblo, se ha hecho muy popular por su particular manera de entretener a los clientes recitándoles sus insólitos poemas. La vida transcurre plácidamente hasta que recibe la noticia de que un pariente lejano le ha dejado una herencia de cuarenta billones de dólares, una cadena de medios de comunicación, un equipo de fútbol, un equipo de baloncesto y un helicóptero privado.

programme.title: Año Uno
programme.desc: Corinne Jeffries, una mujer dinámica y atractiva, nunca ha superado la muerte de su marido Louie en un desgraciado accidente. A pesar de los años transcurridos, su amor por él sigue intacto. Cuando quedó viuda estaba embarazada y dio luz a Miranda, convertida ya en una hermosa joven. Desde entonces, tuvo el apoyo incondicional de Philip, el mejor amigo de su marido, quien siempre ha estado enamorado de ella. Cuando Louie murió, en el cielo se le brindó la oportunidad de reencarnarse en Alex Finch, un apuesto joven. Al conocer a Miranda por casualidad, Alex/Louie entra de nuevo en la vida de Corinne, desbaratándola por completo.

programme.title: La Balada de Davy Crockett
programme.desc: Mucho antes de su heroico final en El Álamo, Davy Crockett se enfrenta a la frontera salvaje para salvar a sus hijos, secuestrados por un cruel terrateniente. En su viaje, luchará contra peligros y desafíos, demostrando su valentía y amor familiar mientras desafía la injusticia en un mundo implacable.

programme.title: Por un puñado de plomo
programme.desc: Cuatro de los forajidos más infames del Oeste llevan a cabo un audaz asalto a un banco en Bath Water, un pueblo sumergido en la fiebre del oro. La cuadrilla de persecución les pisa los talones, pero el verdadero peligro llega con una revelación impactante. Los bandidos se dan cuenta de que han sido traicionados. ¿Quién se ha atrevido a cruzar a los criminales más peligrosos de la región? Descubre la verdad de la emboscada.

programme.title: Cuatro pistoleros rápidos (Four Fast Guns)
programme.desc: Un pistolero llega a la ciudad de Purgatory afirmando ser el “pacificador” esperado, aunque oculta haber causado la muerte del hombre cuya misión ahora asume. A cambio de una recompensa, decide enfrentarse al jefe criminal local, un líder en silla de ruedas que envía a varios asesinos para eliminarlo.

programme.title: El largo camino a casa (The Long Ride Home)
programme.desc: En el Oeste de la década de 1860, el granjero Jack Fowler vive oculto tras haber matado por error a un hombre al que confundió con el temido pistolero Jack Cole. Mientras intenta reencontrarse con su familia, es perseguido por un vengador decidido y un perturbado que se cree el propio Cole, lo que desata un violento conflicto.

programme.title: Nos llaman Adiós Amigo
programme.desc: Los crímenes de un estafador se atribuyen a un vaquero de buen carácter y rápido con las pistolas que conoce y decide usar como señuelo.

programme.title: Estoy cansado de despertarme contigo
programme.desc: Estoy cansado de despertarme a tu lado narra cuatro parejas: Daniel y Carmina, matrimonio al borde Julián y Alicia, romance fugaz Leonardo y Sofía, amor que crece desde la adolescencia Wendy y Bobby, destino que lo rompe todo. Con historias entrelazadas, descubren que el amor es más complejo de lo que parece.

programme.title: El Pozo
programme.desc: Pilar no se comunica con los otros, vive en su propio mundo de fantasías, hasta que la familia toma una decisión que cambiará el rumbo de sus vidas. Pilar es autista desde los cuatro años, ahora tiene 26. El padre quiere que la internen pero la madre se niega, esto crea un distanciamiento en la pareja. La familia se está resquebrajando: Alejo, el hijo menor, tiene conflictos en la escuela, y con los amigos Pilar sufre ataques cada vez más frecuentes que tornan imposible la convivencia. Finalmente, la internan. Encontrará otra manera de vivir, pero algo sucederá que cambiará el rumbo de la familia.

programme.title: Las Cosas Como Son
programme.desc: Jerónimo es un antisocial lugareño que alquila habitaciones de su casa a expatriados para poder husmear en sus pertenencias. Un día llega Sanna, una chica que cambiará la vida de Jerónimo. Empiezan a acercarse hasta que Jerónimo descubre que Sanna esconde algo en su casa.

programme.title: Lleno de ruido y dolor
programme.desc: Soria se une a dos bandidos para robar un banco de un pequeño pueblo de la Patagonia. Pronto se da cuenta de que ha cometido el mayor error de su vida cuando se ve obligado a matar a un inocente.

programme.title: Bienvenue à bord
programme.desc: Isabelle, directora de recursos humanos de una gran empresa de cruceros, ha cometido el error de ser la amante de su jefe. Sin embargo, cuando él decide poner fin a la relación, Isabelle se servirá del puesto que ocupa en la compañía para planear su venganza.

programme.title: El pequeño Nicolás
programme.desc: Inclinados sobre un gran folio en blanco en algún lugar entre Montmartre y Saint-Germain-des-Prés, Jean-Jacques Sempé y René Goscinny dan vida a El pequeño Nicolás, un niño risueño y travieso. La suya es una infancia alegre, llena de juegos, diversión, bromas, aprendizaje, complicidad, peleas y castigos. Las aventuras de Nicolás le llevan al estudio de sus creadores, donde habla con ellos de forma distendida. Sempé y Goscinny le cuentan cómo se conocieron y se hicieron amigos, y también responden a preguntas sobre su carrera, su infancia y sus ambiciones.

programme.title: Una pequeña mentira
programme.desc: Théo es un niño que vive empeñado en levantarle el ánimo a su padre, Laurent, un tipo solitario y completamente desilusionado con la vida. La oportunidad se presenta cuando Theó está a punto de ser admitido en un importante club de fútbol inglés, pero debido a su pequeña estatura es finalmente rechazado. Para no darle una mala noticia a su padre, Théo no se atreve a confesárselo, lo que da pie a una pequeña mentira que muy pronto le vendrá muy grande.

programme.title: Testigo virtual
programme.desc: Thomas asiste en directo desde su web al asesinato de Cathy. Al querer llamar a la policía se dá cuenta de que no tiene ni su nombre ni su dirección a pesar de llevar varios meses chateando con ella. Thomas se ve implicado en la investigación que realiza Claire, una joven especialista de la delincuencia informática. Las indagaciones les conducen hasta el hermano de Thomas que al parecer tiene relación con una organización criminal que actúa en directo por Internet. Pero a Claire le retiran el asunto de la noche a la mañana. Entonces, ella y Thomas deciden colocar una trampa con la que esperan revelar toda la verdad.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Alpha son tres jóvenes amigos criminales que se separaron en un momento determinado de su vida debido a un robo fallido. Ocho años después vuelven a estar juntos, cada uno eligiendo diferentes estilos de vida.

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: Año de Gracia
programme.desc: Gràcia es una mujer de sesenta y pico años que vive sola y se siente muy abandonada. La pesada soledad le acerca hasta David, un joven estudiante de veinte años a quien ofrece una habitación en su casa a cambio de algo que no tiene y que le hace mucha falta.

programme.title: El pomo azul
programme.desc: Soledad, que forma una pareja aparentemente consolidada con Juan, busca el piso más apropiado para su futuro en común.

programme.title: The Perfect Husband
programme.desc: A married couple decide to spend a weekend in a remote cabin, but the romantic journey takes a turn for the worse, when a sneaking suspicion becomes pure madness.
